title: ADAPTIVE ACCOUNTABILITY IN NETWORKED MAS: TRACING AND MITIGATING EMERGENT NORMS AT SCALE
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating an 'Adaptive Accountability Framework' for multi-agent systems specifically designed to ensure 'ethical alignment' and 'fairness'. It treats the detection and mitigation of harmful emergent norms as an algorithmic and ethical design problem, incorporating concepts like Rawls' maximin principle and measures of inequality (Gini index) to align agent behavior with societal values.
